Metadata.title: Klecx | Your AI Companion & Creative Studio
Metadata.description: Stream real-time AI answers, generate studio-grade visuals, and accelerate your workflow with Klecx.

Landing.heroDescription: Experience real-time Server-Sent Events streaming, stateful multi-turn reasoning, and instant AI image synthesis in one unified workspace.
Landing.typing1: Stream real-time answers with zero lag...
Landing.typing2: Generate stunning visuals from natural language...
Landing.typing3: Write, debug, and architect production code...
Landing.typing5: Your intelligent companion for every workflow.
Landing.featuresHeading: Engineered for speed, clarity, and creative depth
Landing.featuresSubheading: Everything you need to move from rough idea to polished output in seconds.
Landing.feature1Desc: Watch responses materialize token-by-token over low-latency Server-Sent Events powered by Google's Interactions API.
Landing.feature2Desc: Switch seamlessly between conversational reasoning and high-resolution AI image generation inside any chat thread.
Landing.feature3Desc: Chained interaction IDs preserve deep context across long technical, creative, and analytical sessions.
Landing.feature4Desc: Search across your current conversation or your entire archive of prompts and responses in milliseconds.
Landing.feature5Desc: Syntax-highlighted code blocks, one-click copy, and clean typography built for engineering and research teams.
Landing.feature6Desc: Track real-time token consumption per turn with detailed usage history and account controls.
Landing.ctaTitle: Ready to elevate your daily workflow?
Landing.ctaDescription: Join Klecx today and unlock 10,000 free starter tokens for real-time AI chat and image generation.
Landing.footerTagline: Built for thinkers, builders, and creators.

verifyEmail.subject: Verify your Klecx email address
verifyEmail.heading: Verify your email address
verifyEmail.body: Thank you for joining Klecx. Please verify your email address to activate your account and start using your AI workspace.
verifyEmail.disclaimer: This verification link will expire in 24 hours. If you did not create a Klecx account, please disregard this email.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your Klecx password
resetPassword.heading: Reset your password
resetPassword.body: We received a request to reset your Klecx password. Click the button below to choose a new, secure password.
resetPassword.disclaimer: This link will expire in 1 hour. If you did not request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email. Your password remains unchanged.

invitation.subject: {inviterName} invited you to join {teamOrProjectName} on Klecx
invitation.heading: You've been invited to collaborate
invitation.body: {inviterName} has invited you to join "{teamOrProjectName}" as a {role} on Klecx.
invitation.disclaimer: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can safely ignore this email.

newSignIn.subject: Security Alert: New sign-in to your Klecx account
newSignIn.heading: New sign-in detected
newSignIn.body: A new sign-in to your Klecx account was detected on {time} from {device} ({ipAddress}, {location}).
newSignIn.disclaimer: If this was you, no action is required. If you did not sign in at this time, please change your password immediately.

passwordChanged.subject: Security Alert: Your Klecx password was changed
passwordChanged.heading: Password changed successfully
passwordChanged.body: The password for your Klecx account was successfully updated on {time}.
passwordChanged.disclaimer: If you performed this change, you can safely ignore this email. If you did NOT make this change, please contact support immediately.

shareCreated.subject: Your shared workspace link for "{title}" is ready
shareCreated.heading: Shared workspace link created
shareCreated.body: A share link was generated for your workspace "{title}". Anyone with access can view the conversation according to the permissions set.
shareCreated.disclaimer: You can revoke or modify sharing permissions at any time from your workspace settings.

creditsLow.subject: Notice: Your Klecx token balance is running low
creditsLow.heading: Token balance low
creditsLow.body: You have {remainingCredits} tokens remaining in your Klecx account balance. Top up your tokens to ensure uninterrupted AI streaming and generation.
creditsLow.disclaimer: You can manage auto-refill or upgrade your subscription plan anytime in settings.

paymentFailed.subject: Action Required: Payment failed for your Klecx subscription
paymentFailed.heading: Payment attempt failed
paymentFailed.body: We were unable to process your payment. Please update your billing method to keep your subscription active.
paymentFailed.bodyWithReason: We were unable to process your payment due to: {reason}. Please update your billing method to keep your subscription active.
paymentFailed.disclaimer: We will automatically retry charging your payment method in the next few days.
